about: Leamington is a municipality at the tip of Ontario’s Essex County, on Lake Erie near Point Pelee. It is a major greenhouse-vegetable centre and a gateway to Point Pelee National Park and Pelee Island ferry connections. The lakeshore, marina, and agricultural hinterland shape the place more than inland industry alone. About 30,000 people live in Leamington.
